messages:
maya: Heads-up — lights-out window tonight 23:00-02:00 UTC. Doing low-priority squelch across infra while we push kernel patch.

simon: Got it. What are the exact squelch rules?

maya: plan: set-alert-squelch for alerts tagged `batch-gpu` and `noncritical` duration 3h; keep P0/P1 live, route P0 to oncall+mobile, P1 to oncall channel only. small change to routing: suppress channel #eng-runtime for noise, route to #eng-oncall directly.

ana: can you paste the exact CLI? I'll run it from bastion.

maya: sure —
```
alertctl set-squelch --selector 'tags:batch-gpu||severity:noncritical' --duration 3h
alertctl route-set --severity P0 --dest oncall-pager
alertctl route-set --severity P1 --dest #eng-oncall
```

oncall-bot: Scheduled squelch for selector `tags:batch-gpu||severity:noncritical` from 23:00 to 02:00 UTC. ID=sch-2026-05-10-1

simon: also enabling a temporary threshold bump for tokenization-failure rate alert — +2x for window to avoid noisy flaps.

ben: I'm swapping into oncall at 00:00 UTC, @maya can you handoff any escalations then? I'll be online from phone.

maya: @ben confirmed. Checklist: 1) review active P0s (none currently), 2) confirm squelch ID, 3) verify routing with `alertctl status`, 4) keep slack notifications open and DM call if P0.

ben: ack. I'll run `alertctl status` at handoff and post the snapshot.

ana: FYI — autoscaler job will trigger a scale event at 23:15, might generate WARNs. Those are expected.

simon: thanks — I'll add a note in the incident playbook about the autoscaler noise so people don't escalate.

ben: snapshot: `alertctl status --all` -> shows sch-2026-05-10-1 active, P1->#eng-oncall, P0->pager. Taking over now. :phone: 

maya: thx, handing over. ping if anything odd. :thumbsup:
